recognize_zh: 這是 Giemsa 染色的薄切片（塑膠包埋型），滿視野中大型淋巴樣細胞，核呈泡狀、可見小核仁，夾雜少數小淋巴球與胞質淡染的巨噬細胞，符合反應性淋巴組織（生發中心）中轉化細胞為主的區域。
features: Predominance of medium to large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei
Fine to open chromatin with one or more small, distinct nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; cell borders visible in the thin section
Admixed small lymphocytes with dense dark nuclei, concentrated at the upper right
Scattered macrophages with abundant pale cytoplasm and occasional apoptotic debris
Heterogeneous (polymorphous) population rather than a monotonous sheet
describe_en: Giemsa-stained thin section of lymphoid tissue shows a cellular field composed predominantly of medium to large transformed lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with small mature lymphocytes and scattered pale macrophages containing debris. The population is heterogeneous, with a mixture of cell sizes and no monotonous sheet of atypical cells. Architecture cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a reactive germinal center-rich area of normal lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: DLBCL forms sheets of monotonous large cells effacing architecture, whereas this field retains a mixed population of small lymphocytes, transformed cells, and tingible-body-type macrophages.
Burkitt shows uniform medium-sized cells with a very high mitotic rate and a diffuse starry-sky pattern, not the variable cell sizes seen here.
Neoplastic follicles lack polarization and tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-positive, which requires architecture and immunostains beyond this field.
